details.description: Post's front face carries a dense printed ruled/tick-mark scale (short horizontal dashes stacked the full visible length), like a ruler or measuring tape. Post cross-section is a rounded-edge rectangular extrusion, cream/off-white.

Head housing's lower lens box, front-lateral face: a large knurled/serrated circular ring (focus/zoom control) dominates the face; a small blue accent button/dot sits on the box's proximal (post-facing) side; a thin ribbed horizontal grip strip runs along the box's bottom edge. Mirror flap above shows a matte-to-semi-gloss reflective panel, not a pure blown-out mirror at this angle.

Rear tip of the head housing's chevron: the mirror flap's rear point and the lens box's rear point meet at a sharp wedge apex, confirming the true boomerang/chevron silhouette (not a rounded fold) -- cream, no additional surface marks.

Two distinct blue knurled thumbscrew knobs on the post at different heights: an upper main clamp knob mounted through a cream bracket where the horizontal arm's post-side end pivots (this is the height/angle clamp for the whole arm assembly), and a smaller secondary knob further down clamping a second cream bracket lower on the post (likely a rotation lock for the post-to-base joint). Both knobs are vivid mid-blue with a knurled rim.

Platen glass shows concentric fresnel-ring relief converging toward the plate's center, visible as faint curved arc lines. Frame bezel is cream with small darker square corner clips at each mitred corner. A small white rectangular label plate sticker sits on the front-left frame edge (text illegible).

Platen frame's right-front mitred corner meeting the base's right side: a small right-angle corner bracket/clip is visible at the joint, plus a single small dark screw or rivet dot just below the corner on the cream frame.

Left carrying-handle recess is NOT a rounded-rectangle side pocket as first assumed from the full frame -- it is a triangular wedge notch cut directly into the base's vertical corner edge, cream-colored on the recessed interior faces against the dark charcoal exterior shell. Corrects image-analysis.md's Layer 3 guess.

details.description: Base front-right corner control cluster: blue→yellow→red gradient arc decal (red pointer needle visible near the yellow/red boundary), a small round secondary gauge dial with its own red needle just left of the arc, a 2-position black rocker power switch left of that, and the main blue rotary control knob below the arc's center. A small round bolt/nub sits on the cream top-frame edge above this cluster.

Confirms the gradient arc + small round secondary gauge + main blue knob cluster from a slightly different crop angle -- same features as zone-r2c1, no new marks; corner fillet radius of the base body clearly visible here.
